ai_summary: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd. is conducting a Non-Deal Roadshow (NDR) with institutional investors and analysts from November 25-27, 2026, a standard investor relations initiative to enhance market engagement. The company emphasizes that discussions will adhere strictly to public domain information, with their Q2 and half-year FY 2026-27 investor presentation already available online for transparency. This communication is a routine compliance update, presenting no immediate material impacts or red flags.
